recordings.summary: PT-BR rundown of the 1.0.1.2 hotfix (air-staff combo fix etc.). No raid speedrun content. One viewer comment there (luanrodrigo7934, https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=CoqQA4itwVs&lc=UgxrxEYbMkKktaxe9RF4AaABAg) reports the floor having no collision in the second Kuldra area after the first TP, and the same on the rock skip. That matches the Commander-teleport fall-through hazard.
